solution.title: Oracle C2M Monitoring & Alerting with Dynatrace

products.name: Oracle C2M Monitoring & Alerting with Dynatrace — Commercial
products.short_description: Set up Dynatrace monitoring and alerting for Oracle C2M and WebLogic 14c — instrument the tiers, build dashboards, define standardized alerts — so the team sees problems before users do, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See C2M health in Dynatrace before users feel it

Once C2M is live, you need to see problems before users do. This solution sets up Dynatrace monitoring and alerting for Oracle C2M and its WebLogic 14c middleware: instrument the JVM/WebLogic tiers, build the service/infra dashboards, and define standardized alerts on the signals that matter — so the team responds to health, not surprises, pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what to monitor across C2M/WebLogic (JVM, services, batch, endpoints) and how Dynatrace instruments and alerts on it.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Dynatrace tenant/OneAgent, C2M environment access, alerting destinations).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to instrument the WebLogic/JVM tiers with Dynatrace, build the C2M dashboards, and define standardized alerts + notification, then validate coverage, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (instrumented, dashboards live, alerts fire) plus Best Practices for alert tuning and noise reduction.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M health visible in Dynatrace — tiers instrumented, dashboards live, standardized alerts firing — so the team responds to problems before users feel them.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MDYNA-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of Dynatrace monitoring coverage for the C2M / WebLogic estate
    • OC2MDYNA-Remediation.sh — print the intended fix for a C2M monitoring coverage/config gap (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MDYNA-Report.sh — read-only monitoring coverage / health snapshot for the C2M estate
    • OC2MDYNA-ScopeHelper.sh — build the in-scope C2M host / tier target list for pilot and expansion
    • OC2MDYNA-Validation.sh — read-only validation that C2M tiers are instrumented, tagged, and alerted

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
